modules.purpose: Maintained Lotus V1: 153 rebased implementation commits plus exact published release metadata; historical release tags and archive/lotusv1 retained separately

migration_requirements: Recover exact validated source commits and complete reachable history before changing build consumers.
Convert build, test, benchmark and CI entrypoints to use pinned submodule source without mailbox replay.
Validate fresh authenticated submodule checkout, source-tree identity and builds before retiring legacy entrypoints.
Preserve existing workspaces, dirty work, running production nodes, chain data, release refs and published assets.
Keep historical benchmark source identities and their data reproducible through preserved refs.
Use existing givelotus/lotusd: main for V2, archive/lotusv1 for historical V1, exact release tags; preserve existing master and release assets.
required_order: Reconcile every retained change into its proper shared or chain-specific owner.
Fold bug repairs into the commits that introduced them; leave no fixup!/squash! commits or standalone repair-only mailboxes.
Apply the reconciled commits linearly on the exact upstream base and verify source-tree equivalence, intermediate prerequisites and required tests.
Only after this checkpoint, create private source repositories and install their pinned submodules.
